en.headline: Customs seize cigarettes worth HK$1.88 million at Man Kam To
en.dek: Officers found about 360,000 suspected illicit cigarettes mixed with vegetables on an inbound truck and arrested the driver.
body: Customs said officers at Man Kam To Control Point on Wednesday stopped an inbound goods vehicle declared as carrying vegetables and found suspected illicit cigarettes mixed among the produce.

About 360,000 sticks were found in 63 foam boxes, Customs said. The haul was estimated to have a market value of about HK$1.88 million and a dutiable value of about HK$1.18 million. The truck was seized.
A 62-year-old local man, the driver, was arrested. He has been released on bail while the investigation continues. He has not been charged.

Customs said smuggling unmanifested cargo is an offence under the Import and Export Ordinance, and dealing in, possessing or selling illicit cigarettes is an offence under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. Each carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years in prison on conviction.

zh.headline: 海關文錦渡檢約36萬支懷疑私煙
zh.dek: 入境運菜貨車的63個發泡膠箱混有懷疑私煙，市值約188萬元，司機被捕保釋。
body: 海關表示，周三在文錦渡管制站截查一輛報稱載有蔬菜的入境貨車，在貨物中發現混雜的懷疑私煙。
海關說，63個發泡膠箱內檢獲約36萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約188萬元，應課稅值約118萬元。涉案貨車已被扣查。
一名62歲本地男司機被捕，已獲准保釋候查，案件仍在調查，尚未落案起訴。
海關指出，根據《進出口條例》，輸入未列艙單貨物屬違法；根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有或售賣私煙亦屬違法。兩項罪行一經定罪，最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
